title: Carve 0.2 inline atoms
description: The forms whose characters are taken as one token (C2-I-005). The scan tries them before brackets and delimiters; nothing opens, closes or is matched inside one, and of two atoms the one that starts first wins. Sorted by name.

name.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

opener.description: The characters that start the atom.

opener_run.description: The character whose run starts the atom; the opener is the whole run.

opener_min.description: The lowest length of the opener run.

closer.description: The characters that end the atom, or `line_end`, or `run_of_opener_length` for a run of the opener character of exactly the opener length.

prefix.description: Characters glued before the opener of the base atom.

base.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

suffix_opener.description: Characters glued behind the closed base atom that start the marker.

suffix_closer.description: The character that ends the marker.

first.description: Characters. An entry is one character, or a range written as two characters joined by a hyphen, both ends included.

rest.description: Characters. An entry is one character, or a range written as two characters joined by a hyphen, both ends included.

chars.description: Characters. An entry is one character, or a range written as two characters joined by a hyphen, both ends included.

joiner.description: A character that may stand between two runs of `chars`, one at a time.

must_contain.description: A character class the name must hold at least once.

not_last.description: Characters. An entry is one character, or a range written as two characters joined by a hyphen, both ends included.

not_first.description: Characters. An entry is one character, or a range written as two characters joined by a hyphen, both ends included.

excluded.description: Characters. An entry is one character, or a range written as two characters joined by a hyphen, both ends included.

may_be_empty.description: True when the empty string fits the shape.

non_ascii.description: Which characters outside ASCII fit besides `chars`: every one except a format character (general category Cf) and a control character.

suffix_name.description: A shape of a name or a value. `chars`: every character is one of these. `first` and `rest`: the first character and the ones after it. `excluded`: any character but these. `not_first`, `not_last`: characters the name does not start or end with; the longest run that fits is taken.

requires.description: A fact that must hold for the atom to form.

at.description: Where the opener must stand. One of the entries is enough.

content.description: How the characters between opener and closer are taken.

content_min.description: The lowest count of content characters.

reads_escapes.description: False when a backslash inside the atom is content (C2-I-013).

crosses_lines.description: True when the atom may hold a line break.

nests.description: False when an opener inside the atom is content.

trim.description: What is removed from the content.

unclosed.description: What happens without a closer. `text`: the opener is literal text. `runs_to_content_end`: the atom never fails. `next_brace_rule`: the brace is read by the next entry of inline-braces.json.

host.description: True when an attribute block glued to the end of the form attaches to it (C2-I-036, C2-I-037).

transparent_to_neighbors.description: True when the characters on its two sides are tested as if they were glued (C2-I-026).

not_in.description: Bodies in which the opener is content or text.

ends_at.description: Where the atom ends, whichever comes first.

file.description: The data file of this directory that defines the shape.
